standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

Minutes read are the draft attached to the 2026-10-28 agenda; not yet approved
Meeting not yet held as of 2026-10-24; agenda posted but not included
Several consent-agenda votes (2025-05-14, 2025-05-28, 2025-06-11) and the 2025-08-25 lease vote record a 5-0 or 4-0 roll but no mover or second; mover and second are null
Consent items carry the roll of the single consent-agenda vote; pulled items carry their own vote

Applicants for site plans, plats, special exceptions and rezonings (3400 NW 135 St, 14301 NW 27 Ave, 2466 Ali Baba Ave, 13449 NW 42 Ave, 1700 Service Road, 13060 Cairo Lane, 3570/3530/3450 NW 135 St) are not named in the minutes or titles; the contractor on the seven Cairo Lane/NW 127 St change orders and the NW 127 St water-main change order is not named either

Budget hearings (2025-09-09, 2025-09-24, 2026-09-08, 2026-09-23) and special meetings of 2025-11-14 and 2025-11-24 were read; they hold only millage, budget and code items, with no private-party actions
Interlocal agreements, state and federal grants, mutual aid, RFP issuances naming no vendor, code amendments, scholarships and union contracts are excluded under the standard

Bass: her current continuous service began with her appointment on 2021-08-18 (sworn in 2021-09-08) to fill the late Commissioner Alvin Burke's seat; she also served Nov 2018 - Nov 2020 (unexpired Pigatt term) but was off the commission Dec 2020 - Aug 2021, so that earlier term is a separate tenure and is not covered.
Ervin: first sat on 2022-12-14 (elected Nov 2022); actions from 2022-12-14 on are hers. The 2022-11-14 meeting still had the old board (Davis, Dominguez).

Minutes not posted for: Regular meetings 2022-06-08 and 2022-07-13 were read from attachments to later agendas (Opa-Locka RCM Minutes); no minutes found for Regular meetings 2023-11-22, 2023-12-27, 2024-06-12, 2024-10-09, 2024-11-27, 2024-12-25 (agenda only or cancelled), Special meetings 2023-08-16 (cancelled), 2023-09-20, 2023-11-29, Workshop 2021-10-20.

2024-06-12 and 2024-10-09 regular meetings: agenda and packet posted but no minutes attached to any later agenda through Jan 2025; their private-party items (e.g. Landshore Phase II canal contract on 2024-10-09, re-heard 2024-10-23) are not listed for those dates.

Votes come from the clerk's action summary minutes, which list each member's vote. Consent items carry the single consent-agenda roll; pulled items carry their own vote. Where a member is missing from a roll (late arrival, virtual attendance) the vote is "unknown".

Applicants for most site plans, plats, variances, special exceptions and development agreements are not named in the minutes or titles; these carry "Owner of <address> (not named in minutes)" with the owner of record in owners.json.
Older minutes (2021-2022) are scanned PDFs with an OCR text layer; dollar amounts in some titles are garbled and were left out where unreadable.

Excluded under the standard: RFP issuances naming no vendor, budget amendments, code and land development regulation text amendments, interlocal agreements and state/county grants, scholarships, appointments, employment of charter officers, city-hosted events.
